subject: SUBTRACT statement
notes: Both literal positions the rule names, reached by different binder paths (the operand list and format 2's FROM phrase); both COBOL0844. The over-rejection guard in the literal-1 header cites 8.3.3.6.3 SR1 a) ('the only figurative constant permitted is ZERO ... without the ALL phrase'), which is what actually keeps SUBTRACT ZERO FROM N legal -- 14.9.44.2 Format 1's slot is {identifier-1 | literal-1}, not an arithmetic expression, so 8.8.1.1 answers a different question and appears only as the name of the screen that reports the rejection.
